identity.name: Series 8 Automatic
identity.one_liner: The Series 8 automatic with the in-house caliber 0950 — Citizen's mid-range manufacture line, positioned between the Tsuyosa and the high-end Citizen Chronomaster.

narrative.story: The Series 8 is Citizen's mid-tier mechanical line, launched globally in 2023 (sold in Japan since the 2010s as the "8" series). The 0950 caliber is a modern Citizen automatic with a 50-hour reserve and anti-magnetic resistance to 16,000 A/m. The 40mm case comes in smooth, fluted, and integrated-bracelet variants. The Series 8 is the most-cited Citizen mechanical above the entry tier and the watch a collector cites when they want Japanese automatic watchmaking with anti-magnetic specs at the $700 price point.
narrative.collector_notes: The 0950 caliber is the modern Citizen mechanical platform; it differs from the older 8210 in the Tsuyosa by adding anti-magnetic shielding and a longer reserve.
